root_cause: JsonTree flattened exact JSON object-key segments into dotted text. Network and Framework runners split that text, so one literal key named feeds.news selected the nested feeds/news value. Network's credential-safe save boundary also discarded the new array representation until repaired.
representation: New tree selections use a string[] key_path in saved JSON config. Existing string key_path values retain their original dotted semantics: Network skips empty segments, Framework preserves interior empty segments. Display formatting is never parsed for extraction.
source_scope: JsonTree emits and compares exact key segments, including literal dots, brackets, and empty names.
Network preview, saved capture replay, credential-safe save sanitization, and config schema retain and resolve segment arrays.
Framework preview and saved pattern replay resolve segment arrays inside the self-contained in-page runner; its config schema accepts both persisted representations.
Existing Network component-test selection mocks were updated from old string callbacks to array callbacks; read-only Debug JsonTree callers need no migration.
